exercises.question: 在单词 "ship" 中, 字母组合 "sh" 的发音方式是?
exercises.explanation: sh、ch、th 是辅音字母组合, 两个字母手拉手合发一个新音, 不是各发各的。A、C、D 都把它们拆开读了, 所以不对。
options: A. 先发 s 的音, 再发 h 的音
B. 两个字母合在一起发一个新的音
C. 只发 h 的音, 不发 s
D. 只发 s 的音, 不发 h

exercises.question: 在英语句子 'I like apples' 中, 根据句子重音规则, 哪一种说法正确概括了通常需要重读的词？

B. like
C. apples
D. like 和 apples

exercises.explanation: cat 由三个音组成:/k/ 是舌后音,发音时送气;/æ/ 嘴巴张大,像打哈欠的样子;/t/ 舌尖抵上齿龈后送气。B 项 /e/ 嘴巴不够大;C 项用字母 c 而非音标;D 项 /ʌ/ 嘴型偏圆,都不对。

exercises.question: 朗读短语 "an apple" 时,正确的连读方式是哪一项?
exercises.explanation: 辅音 n 碰到元音 a 时要连读,正确读法是 a-napple,B 正确。A 没连读,C 中间停顿不对,D 重复读音错误。
options: A. an / a-pple,每个单词都读清楚
B. a-nap-ple,把 n 和 apple 连起来念成一个音节
C. an-ap-ple,中间停顿一下再读
D. a-na-pple,把 an 重复读两遍

exercises.question: 在短语 "not at all" 的朗读中,前后两个 /t/ 都应该 ____ 发音,而中间那个 /t/ 因为处于两词之间,应该 ____,只保留口型。
exercises.explanation: "not at all" 中,第一个 /t/ 位于单词词首,第三个 /t/ 位于单词词尾,两者都不受爆破音相邻的影响,需要完整发出,做到完全爆破;而中间的 /t/ 紧跟在 /t/ 之后（"not" 的结尾和 "at" 的开头相邻）,属于两个爆破音相遇的情况,按照失去爆破规则,第一个 /t/ 不完全闭气爆破,只做口型稍作停顿即可,这样听起来才自然地道。
options: A. 完整（完全爆破） / 完全不发音
B. 完整（完全爆破） / 失去爆破（只做口型）
C. 失去爆破（只做口型） / 完整（完全爆破）
D. 都失去爆破 / 都不发音
exercises._original_question: 朗读 "not at all" 时,中间那个 t 应该 ____,前后两个 t 要 ____,这样听起来才像英语母语者的自然读法。
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: 朗读句子 "I went to the park to see my friend" 时, 正确的意群划分方式是?
exercises.explanation: 英语按意群(meaning group)停顿, 状语 to see my friend 表示目的, 与主句 I went to the park 分属两个意群, 故在 park 后断开。A 切分过细且位置错误; B 把主语与谓语切开, 破坏了句子主干; D 把介词短语 went to 与后面的 park 拆开, 不符合意群原则。
options: A. I / went to the park to see my friend
B. I went / to the park to see my friend
C. I went to the park / to see my friend
D. I went to / the park to see my friend
exercises._original_question: 朗读句子 "I want to buy a red pen" 时, 正确的意群划分方式是?

exercises.question: Mary 的同学怀疑是她弄坏了花瓶，她想强调「不是她弄坏的」，她应该重读句子中的哪个单词？ "I didn't break the vase."
exercises.explanation: 在英语口语中，重读 I 可以强调主语，表示「不是我弄坏的，是别人」的意思，符合语境中 Mary 想撇清责任的需求。重读 didn't 强调否定（确实没弄坏），重读 break 强调动作（不是打碎，可能是碰倒），重读 vase 强调宾语（不是这个花瓶，可能是别的）。本题主语是重读重点，故选 A。
options: A. I
B. didn't
C. break
D. vase
exercises._original_question: Mary 的同学怀疑是她弄坏了花瓶,她想强调「不是她弄坏的」,她应该重读句子中的哪个单词? "I didn't break the vase."

exercises.question: 上课时, 我每天背着的那个装书本的东西, 用英文怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 装课本的书包是 schoolbag。window 是窗户, dinner 是晚餐, milk 是牛奶, 都是生活词汇但跟书包没关系。
options: A. schoolbag
B. window
C. dinner
D. milk

exercises.question: 晚饭这顿饭用英文说是 ____.
exercises.explanation: dinner 表示晚餐,对应中文的'晚饭'这顿饭。这里问的是'晚饭这顿饭',而不是吃的内容,所以选 dinner。
options: A. breakfast
B. lunch
C. dinner
D. supper
exercises._original_question: 晚饭吃的是米饭和菜, 这个饭用英文说是 ____.
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: 妈妈切了一个红红的苹果递给你,这个水果的英文单词是哪一个?
exercises.explanation: 苹果是 apple,符合题目说的水果。banana 是香蕉、fish 是鱼、red 是红色,都不对。
options: A. banana
B. apple
C. fish
D. red

exercises.question: Tom 每天早上在 ___ 刷牙,晚上又在同一个地方洗澡。这个地方用英语怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 刷牙和洗澡都在 bathroom(浴室)。bedroom 是睡觉的,kitchen 是做饭的,classroom 是学校的教室,都不对。
options: A. bedroom
B. bathroom
C. kitchen
D. classroom

exercises.question: The word "runner" comes from the verb "run". In the sentence "Tom is a fast runner", what part of speech is "runner"?
exercises.explanation: Runner 指「跑步的人」, 是一个名词 (n.), 用来称呼人, 不是动词或形容词。其他三项都没看清它「指人」的身份。
options: A. A verb (v.) — because it comes from run
B. A noun (n.) — it names a person
C. An adjective (adj.) — it describes speed
D. An adverb (adv.) — it tells how Tom runs

exercises.question: Thomas Edison was a great ______. He ______ the light bulb and changed people's lives.
exercises.explanation: 第一空指人,应用 inventor;第二空是过去时动作,用 invented。A 和 D 的 invent 是动词原形,不能单独作过去时;C 的 invention 是名词,不能作谓语。
options: A. invent / invention
B. inventor / invented
C. invention / inventor
D. inventor / invent

exercises.question: 老师教我们用前缀猜词义:un- 表示「不」,re- 表示「再、又」。下面哪个单词的意思推断是错误的?
exercises.explanation: 正确:rewrite 应是「再写」(re-=再),不是「不写」(un-=不)。其他三项都用对了前缀意思。
options: A. unhappy = 不开心 (happy + un-)
B. replay = 重玩 (play + re-)
C. rewrite = 不写 (write + un-)
D. rewrite = 再写 (write + re-)

exercises.question: 妈妈出门前对我说:"Please ____ your little sister while I'm away." 这句话的意思是让我做什么?
exercises.explanation: look after 是固定搭配,意为"照顾",所以正确答案是 B。A 项 look for 才表示"寻找",C 项 pick up 是"捡起",都不是 looking after 的意思。
options: A. 寻找妹妹
B. 照顾妹妹
C. 捡起妹妹的东西
D. 看着妹妹离开

exercises.question: After the long race, Jane noticed a small hole in her sock because the thread had begun to ______. What does "run" mean here?
exercises.explanation: 语境是袜子上的线脱丝,所以 run 意为'抽丝、纵向脱线',C 对。A 是跑步,B 是经营,D 是竞选,均不符合袜子破损的场景。
options: A. To move quickly by foot
B. To manage or operate something
C. To become undone in a line, as in fabric
D. To be a candidate in an election

exercises.question: My grandma often _____ me a story about her childhood. Which word fits best?
exercises.explanation: tell a story 是固定搭配,表示"讲故事";且 tell 后接双宾语结构(tell sb. sth.),me(人)是间接宾语,a story 是直接宾语,故用 tells 最恰当。says 后接说话内容,speaks/talks 后一般接语言或 to sb.,均不符合此句结构。
options: A. says
B. speaks
C. talks
D. tells
exercises._original_question: My grandma often _____ me stories about her childhood when she was young. Which word fits best?

exercises.question: 请用 say / tell / speak / talk 的正确形式填空: He _____ English fluently and can _____ a story clearly to the children.
exercises.explanation: speak 后接语言, speak English 表示'说英语'; tell a story 为固定搭配,表示'讲故事'。故选 speaks; tell。
options: A. speaks; tell
B. speaks; say
C. talks; tell
D. says; speak
exercises._original_question: 请用 say / tell / speak 的正确形式填空: He _____ English fluently and can _____ a speech in front of hundreds
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: 下面哪个句子是完整的主谓宾结构?
exercises.explanation: B 中 I(主语) play(谓语) football(宾语)三块积木齐全。A、D 缺宾语,C 不是主谓宾句型。
options: A. She runs
B. I play football
C. He is happy
D. Tom dances

exercises.question: 选出正确的句子:'妈妈在喝牛奶。'用英文应该怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 英文中表示一般现在时的'喝牛奶',主语 Mom 是第三人称单数,谓语动词 drink 需加 s 变为 drinks,牛奶 milk 是不可数名词,不加 s,所以正确句子是 Mom drinks milk。B 项动词未加 s;C 项主语加了 s;D 项用了现在分词,不符合一般现在时语法。
options: A. Mom drinks milk.
B. Mom drink milks.
C. Moms drinks milk.
D. Mom drinking milk.
exercises._original_question: 看图补全句子:Mom ____ ____(妈妈在喝牛奶)
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: I ___ milk every day. 哪个选项可以正确填空？
exercises.explanation: every day 表示天天都做的事,用一般现在时,主语是 I,动词用原形 drink。B drank 是过去式,C drinking 是现在分词,D will drink 是将来时,都不符合。
options: A. drink
B. drank
C. drinking
D. will drink

exercises.question: Look at the picture: Tom is reading a book right now. Which sentence is correct?
exercises.explanation: 现在正在读书,用现在进行时 be (is) + reading。A 是一般现在时,C 是一般过去时,D 缺少 be 动词,结构错误。
options: A. Tom reads a book.
B. Tom is reading a book.
C. Tom read a book.
D. Tom reading a book.

exercises.question: 妈妈明天想带我去公园,但天气预报说可能会下雨。天气预报预测天气时,下列哪句话最适合用 be going to 来表达?
exercises.explanation: 天气预报是基于已有迹象对未来的预测,常用 be going to 表示。It is going to rain tomorrow. (明天将会下雨) 符合天气预报预测的语境。A、C 是已计划要做的事,虽有计划性但与'天气预报预测'主题不符;B 用 will 一般表示临时决定或推测,不是天气预报最典型的表达。
options: A. I am going to fly a kite tomorrow.
B. It will rain tomorrow.
C. I am going to learn swimming this weekend.
D. It is going to rain tomorrow.
exercises._original_question: 妈妈明天想带我去公园,但天气预报说可能会下雨。下列哪句话最适合描述这种情况?

exercises.question: 桌子上有一个苹果,用 there be 句型应该怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 一个苹果是单数,用 is;an apple 后名词加 on the table。A 主谓不一致,C 是 is 配复数,D are 配单数名词,都错。
options: A. There are an apple on the table.
B. There is an apple on the table.
C. There is apples on the table.
D. There are apple on the table.

exercises.question: 桌上有一杯 water 和两个 apple, 下面哪个说法是正确的?
exercises.explanation: apple 可以一颗颗数清, 复数加 -s 变 apples;water 只能论杯算, 不可数, A、C、D 都错。
options: A. water 是可数名词, 可以说 two waters
B. apple 是可数名词, 可以说 three apples
C. water 和 apple 都是不可数名词
D. apple 是不可数名词, water 是可数名词

exercises.question: My brother ______ his homework already, so he can play games now.
exercises.explanation: 句中有 already(已经)和 so...now(所以现在...),强调过去动作对现在的影响,应用现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词,主语 brother 是第三人称单数,用 has done。A 项 did 是一般过去时,只陈述过去不联系现在;C 项 does 是一般现在时;D 项 will do 是将来时,均不符合语境。
options: A. did
B. has done
C. does
D. will do

exercises.question: When I called Jenny last night at 9 o'clock, she ______ a book in her room.
exercises.explanation: 过去某时刻正在进行的动作要用 was/were + 动词-ing, 所以选 was reading。B 是过去一般时(强调完成动作), C 和 D 是现在时, 都不符合 at 9 o'clock last night 这个过去时间点。
options: A. was reading
B. read
C. reads
D. is reading

exercises.question: 下列哪个句子使用的是被动语态?
exercises.explanation: B 项主语 the cake 是动作承受者,有 was + eaten(过去分词),并用 by 表明执行者 Tom,是标准的被动语态。A、C、D 都是主动语态,主语 Tom 在做动作。
options: A. Tom ate the cake yesterday.
B. The cake was eaten by Tom yesterday.
C. Tom eats the cake every day.
D. Tom is eating the cake now.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses an object clause (宾语从句) correctly?
exercises.explanation: B 正确, 主语 he 对应 is。A、C 主语和 be 动词不一致;D 缺少 be 动词, 不是完整从句。
options: A. I think that he are right.
B. I think that he is right.
C. I think that they is right.
D. I think that he right.

exercises.question: I have a friend ___ likes eating pizza very much. Which word is the best to fill in the blank?
exercises.explanation: 先行词 a friend 是人,关系词用 who。A 的 which 指物,C 的 what 不作关系词,D 的 where 表地点,都不符合。
options: A. which
B. who
C. what
D. where

exercises.question: 假如我是一只鸟，我就能飞起来。下列翻译中虚拟语气使用正确的是？
exercises.explanation: 虚拟语气中 if 从句无论主语是第几人称，be 动词统一用 were；主句用 would + 动词原形。A 用 am 和 will 不符合虚拟语气；C 主句用 will 错误；D 从句 were 对，但主句 will 应改为 would。
options: A. If I am a bird, I will fly.
B. If I were a bird, I would fly.
C. If I was a bird, I will fly.
D. If I were a bird, I will fly.

exercises.question: My mom enjoys ______ to classical music every evening after dinner.
exercises.explanation: enjoy 后面只能接动名词 doing, 表示享受做某事,所以选 listening。A 是动词原形,不能直接跟在 enjoy 后;B 是 to do 结构,enjoy 不接不定式;D 是过去式,更不符合。
options: A. listen
B. to listen
C. listening
D. listened

exercises.question: Which of the following sentences uses an adverbial clause correctly to express cause (原因)?
exercises.explanation: C 用 because 引出原因,说明下雨是我们待在家的原因。A 是 although 让步,D 是 if 条件,只有 C 正确表原因。
options: A. Although he was tired, he kept on working.
B. I will call you when I get home.
C. Because it was raining heavily, we stayed at home.
D. If you study hard, you will pass the exam.

exercises.question: Fill in the blanks with because / although / if / so: Tom was late for school ____ the bus broke down. ____ he ran very fast, he still missed the morning test.
exercises.explanation: 第一空 because 表原因(车坏了所以迟到),与 was late 构成因果关系;第二空 Although 位于句首表让步(虽然跑得快),后接主句 he still missed the test,逻辑自洽。
options: A. because / because
B. although / because
C. because / Although
D. if / Although
exercises._original_question: Fill in the blanks with because / although / if: Tom was late ____ the bus broke down, ____ he didn'
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目实际提供选项，改为选择题以匹配答案 C 和自动评分器。

exercises.question: Tom's father, _____ is a doctor in our hospital, always encourages him to study hard. Which word should fill in the blank?
exercises.explanation: 先行词 Tom's father 指人,且前有逗号(非限定性),必须用 who 而非 that。which 只能指物,whom 在非限定性从句中通常不单独使用。
options: A. that
B. which
C. who
D. whom

exercises.question: Which of the following sentences is correct?
exercises.explanation: D正确：news是不可数名词，作主语时谓语用单数makes。A错误：brother是第三人称单数，go应加es变goes。B错误：There be句型就近一致，最近主语a pencil是单数，be动词应用is。C错误：neither作主语时谓语用单数has。
options: A. My brother always go to school by bike.
B. There are a pencil and two rulers in the box.
C. Neither of the students have finished the homework.
D. The news from his parents makes her very happy.

exercises.question: Tom 在教室里遇到新同学,他想打招呼,下面哪一句最合适?
exercises.explanation: 见面打招呼用 Hello 并自我介绍,正确。A 是告别,C 是感谢,D 是问年龄,都不对。
options: A. Goodbye, I'm Tom.
B. Hello, I'm Tom.
C. Thank you, Tom.
D. How old are you?

exercises.question: Look at the picture and read the sentence: "There is a ball ____ the box." In the picture, the ball is inside the box. Which word fits the blank?
exercises.explanation: 图中球在盒子里面,所以用 "in"。on 是"在...上面",under 是"在...下面",behind 是"在...后面",都不符合图意。
options: A. on
B. in
C. under
D. behind

exercises.question: Read the passage: 'Last Sunday, Tom and his sister went to the beach. They built a big sandcastle and ate ice cream.' What is the PLACE in this passage?
exercises.explanation: C 'the beach' 是地点,正确。A 是时间,B 是人物,D 是事件中的物品,都不是地点。
options: A. Last Sunday
B. Tom and his sister
C. the beach
D. ice cream

exercises.question: Read the short passage and choose its text type. "Last Sunday, I went to the park with my best friend Lily. We flew a kite, ate ice cream and took many photos. We had a great time together!" This passage is a(n) ____.
exercises.explanation: 开头有'Last Sunday, I went...'是在讲自己的经历,有时间(Last Sunday)、人物(I, Lily)、事件(去公园),是典型的记叙文。A说明文会有因果词, B议论文会表达观点。
options: A. Expository text (说明文)
B. Argumentative text (议论文)
C. Narrative text (记叙文)
D. Poetry (诗歌)

exercises.question: 当你读原版小说遇到生词时,下列哪种做法最符合'通过上下文猜词'的阅读策略?
exercises.explanation: 正确做法是结合上下文猜词义。A 依赖逐字查字典,违背猜词原则;B 跳过句子会丢失语境线索;D 是延后查字典,仍是逐字翻译。只有 C 既不查字典又利用了上下文。
options: A. 立刻翻到词典附录查这个单词的精确含义
B. 跳过句子直接读下一段,看词义能不能自己浮现
C. 结合该词前后句的语境和逻辑,先猜出大意再继续读
D. 把生词抄到本子上,等读完一章再统一查字典

exercises.question: A short passage says: "Every weekend, thousands of plastic bags are used once and thrown away. They end up in the ocean, killing sea animals. It's time to bring your own bag." What is the author's main purpose?
exercises.explanation: C正确,作者列举数据并呼吁行动,目的是说服读者不用塑料袋。B只是借海洋做背景,A是介绍知识非本文目的,D文风严肃非娱乐。
options: A. To explain how plastic bags are made.
B. To describe the beauty of the ocean.
C. To persuade readers to stop using plastic bags.
D. To entertain readers with a story about sea animals.

exercises.question: 老师喊 'Open your book!' 时, 你应该做什么?
exercises.explanation: Open 是'打开', 所以要打开书。B 是 Close 才对; C、D 都是其他指令的动作, 不是 Open your book。
options: A. 打开你的书
B. 合上你的书
C. 把书举起来
D. 站起来

exercises.question: 你想告诉同学你今年 7 岁, 下面哪句话最合适?
exercises.explanation: 介绍自己的年龄用 'I am + 年龄'。B 用 'This is' 介绍物品不对, C 用 'I like' 表示喜好不对, D 用 'It's' 描述物品特征不对。
options: A. I am 7.
B. This is 7.
C. I like 7.
D. It's 7.

exercises.question: 写字母 H 时，应该在四线三格中占哪两格？
exercises.explanation: 大写字母 H 要写在上两格。A 和 D 是小写字母的写法，C 不符合大写字母占位规则。
options: A. 只占中间一格
B. 占上两格（顶到第二条线）
C. 占下两格
D. 占满三格

exercises.question: Listen to the short story: Tom goes to the park with his little sister on Saturday morning. How many people go to the park?
exercises.explanation: 文中提到 Tom 和 his little sister 两个人去公园,故选 B。A 只算了 Tom,C、D 文中没有提到第三、第四个人。
options: A. One
B. Two
C. Three
D. Four

exercises.question: 你扮演顾客走进「商店」, 售货员对你说: "Can I help you?" 你应该怎么回答?
exercises.explanation: 售货员问"Can I help you?"是在打招呼引出购物, 正确回答是说出想买的东西, C 符合。B 是顾客问价格, A 是道别, D 是谢谢, 都不对。
options: A. Goodbye!
B. How much is it?
C. Yes, I'd like an apple, please.
D. Thank you!

exercises.question: 我想写一篇 5 句话的小短文介绍我的好朋友 Lily,下面哪一句写得最好?
exercises.explanation: B 句主谓一致正确,第三人称单数动词都加了 s。 A 漏了 likes 和 is 的 s;C Lily 是单数,不能用 are;D She 是第三人称,are 要换成 is。
options: A. Lily is my friend. She is tall. She like apples. We play together every day. She happy.
B. Lily is my friend. She is tall. She likes apples. We play together every day. She is happy.
C. Lily are my friend. She is tall. She likes apples. We play together every day. She happy.
D. Lily is my friend. She are tall. She likes apples. We play together every day. She is happy.

exercises.question: 请选择正确选项补全句子:Mine cat ____ black. ____ name is Mimi.
exercises.explanation: 第一空填 is,因为 cat 是单数,系动词用 is;第二空填 Its(名词性物主代词),表示'它的名字'。注意:原题'Mine cat'有语法错误,应为'My cat',此处按语法规范补全。C选项的 It's 是 It is 的缩写,后接形容词,不能作名词使用。
options: A. is; Its
B. are; Its
C. is; It's
D. are; It
exercises._original_question: 请帮我把这句介绍小猫的话补完整:Mine cat ____ black. ____ name is Mimi.
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: Tom and Lily are discussing whether students should have homework every day. Lily says: 'I think we should have less homework, because it takes too much time, because we need more time to play and rest.' Which sentence best shows Lily expressing her opinion with reasons?
exercises.explanation: B正确,用'I think...because...'明确立场+两个理由。A只一个理由;C无立场;D是疑问句,没有表达观点。
options: A. I like homework because it is fun.
B. I think we should have less homework, because it takes too much time, because we need more time to play and rest.
C. Homework is so boring every day.
D. Do we really need homework every day?

exercises.question: 你想写一篇介绍自己家乡的小作文，下面哪种段落安排最符合「开头—中间—结尾」的三段式结构？
exercises.explanation: B 项符合开头点题、中间展开、结尾总结的三段式结构。A、C 只是中间内容，没有首尾呼应；D 不分段，结构不清。
options: A. 第一段写家乡的位置，第二段写家乡的食物，第三段写风景
B. 第一段点题说「My hometown is beautiful」，第二段写位置、食物和风景，第三段总结再次扣题
C. 第一段写风景，第二段写食物，第三段写位置
D. 直接把所有内容写在一大段里，不分段落

exercises.question: Mike 准备用「3 遍听写法」练习一段 BBC 新闻。下列哪种做法最符合「第一遍盲听」的要求？
exercises.explanation: 盲听的核心是不看文本先抓大意，B 正确；A 是过度精听，C 属于第二遍，D 是第三遍跟读。
options: A. 边听边把每个生词查出来记在笔记本上
B. 不看文本，直接听一遍，先猜这段新闻大概在讲什么
C. 先通读原文，再播放音频逐句对照
D. 听一句暂停一句，然后跟读模仿发音

exercises.question: In a class debate about "Should students be allowed to use phones at school?", which opening sentence best shows a clear stance?
exercises.explanation: B 用 'I agree because...' 明确表态并给出理由,符合开场结构。A 没立场,C 只描述事实,D 与论点无关,都没清晰表态。
options: A. I don't know, maybe phones are useful or maybe not.
B. I agree because phones can help students learn online.
C. Some students like phones and some students don't like them.
D. Phones are very popular in the world today.

exercises.question: 下面是一篇《My Favorite Teacher》作文的开头句。已知原文使用了如下模板："My hero is my grandma. She is 70. She tells me stories every day." 下列哪个选项是按相同句式结构（My + 名词 + is + 称呼 → She is + 年龄 → She + 动词 + ... every day）写的开头？
exercises.explanation: B 严格套用了原模板的三句结构：第一句主系表交代人物，第二句交代年龄，第三句交代日常动作。选项 A 缺少年龄和日常动作细节；C 是原因状语从句开头，不是模板结构；D 是 there be 引出句，不符合模板。
options: A. My favorite teacher is very kind to us.
B. My favorite teacher is Miss Wang. She is 28. She teaches us English every day.
C. I like my teacher because she is nice.
D. There is a favorite teacher in our school.
exercises._original_question: 命题作文《My Favorite Teacher》开头第一句，下列哪个套用了「My hero is my grandma」句式结构？

exercises.question: Tom 喜欢打篮球。请根据图片（一个男孩在打篮球）补全短文：My _____ name is Tom. His _____ is playing basketball. He often _____ basketball with his friends after school.
exercises.explanation: 本题考查介绍他人的爱好。第一空介绍他的爱好应用 hobby；第二空描述他经常做某事，主语 He 为第三人称单数，谓语动词用 plays，故选 C。
options: A. hobby; plays
B. friend; plays
C. hobby; plays
D. name; playing
exercises._original_question: 把《My Hero》模板换成《My Hobby — Reading》，需替换主语和细节。请填空：My ____ is ____. She is ____. She ____ for me every
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: 早上在学校门口遇见同学,外国小朋友最可能说什么?
exercises.explanation: 外国人见面常说 "How are you" 表示问候。A 是中国人常见的打招呼方式,B 虽是英文但不是最常用的问候,D 是问去向,不符合问候习惯。
options: A. 你吃了吗?
B. Have you had your lunch?
C. How are you?
D. Where are you going?

exercises.question: What do people usually eat on Christmas in Western countries?
exercises.explanation: Christmas in Western countries features turkey as the traditional food. Dumplings and mooncakes are for Spring and Mid-Autumn festivals, zongzi is for Dragon Boat Festival.
options: A. Dumplings
B. Zongzi
C. Turkey
D. Mooncakes

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct for introducing China's famous places in English?
exercises.explanation: B 用 superlative longest 正确介绍了长江是中国最长的河流。A 把长城放错城市;C 应是 highest 而非 lowest;D 故宫不是首都,北京才是。
options: A. The Great Wall is in Shanghai, it is very long.
B. The Yangtze River is the longest river in China.
C. Mount Himalaya is the lowest mountain in China.
D. The Forbidden City is the capital of China.

exercises.question: Which writer is famous for writing plays such as Romeo and Juliet?
exercises.explanation: Shakespeare是英国剧作家,写了《罗密欧与朱丽叶》。A 马克·吐温写小说,B 安徒生写童话,D 鲁迅是中国作家,都和戏剧无关。
options: A. Mark Twain
B. Andersen
C. Shakespeare
D. Lu Xun

exercises.question: In Western culture, Santa Claus giving gifts on Christmas mainly stands for which value?
exercises.explanation: 圣诞老人送礼物体现西方'慷慨给予'的价值观(B)。A是端午屈原的内涵;C是春节阖家团圆的内涵;D是丰收节的特点,均与圣诞节无关。
options: A. Remembering a historical hero
B. Generosity and giving to others
C. Family reunion and togetherness
D. Worshipping nature and harvest

exercises.question: 你想用英语向外国朋友介绍春节发红包的习俗,下面哪个表达最合适?
exercises.explanation: B 项正确说出了红色象征 luck(吉祥)以及红包在春节的祝福含义,贴近'用英语讲中国故事'的要求。A 只说颜色好看,没体现文化内涵;C 张冠李戴,把春节说成圣诞节;D 否认文化寓意,都不对。
options: A. We give red envelopes because red is a beautiful color.
B. We give red envelopes during Chinese New Year because red means luck and good wishes.
C. We give red envelopes on Christmas to say happy birthday.
D. Red envelopes are only for children and have no special meaning.

exercises.question: 你想把妈妈介绍给新同学，下面哪一句是对的？
exercises.explanation: 口语里直接称呼用 mom 更亲切；mother 太正式；a mom 是指某一位妈妈，不是在介绍自己的妈妈；family 是集合名词，不可加 s。
options: A. This is my mom.
B. This is my mother.
C. This is a mom.
D. This is my familys.

exercises.question: Which word means the place where we read books in school?
exercises.explanation: library 是图书角,读书的地方。classroom 是教室,playground 是操场,canteen 是食堂,都不是读书的地点。
options: A. classroom
B. playground
C. library
D. canteen

exercises.question: Your mom wants to buy some apples at the place near your community. Where should you go?
exercises.explanation: 超市是买苹果的地方。library是借书的, park是玩的, police station是警察工作的地方,都不能买苹果。
options: A. library
B. supermarket
C. park
D. police station

exercises.question: Which word means "太阳"?
exercises.explanation: sun 就是太阳,选 B。moon 是月亮,cloud 是云,star 是星星,都不是太阳。
options: A. moon
B. sun
C. cloud
D. star

exercises.question: Tom wants to fill in his "My Health Log" card today. He ran for 20 minutes, ate an egg and an apple, and slept for 9 hours. Which is the correct way to write it?
exercises.explanation: 日志描述过去和习惯用一般现在时,数词 twenty 也可, 但 9 hours 需用阿拉伯数字+复数,A 缺冠词和复数,C 时态错,D 数词与阿拉伯数字混用且时态不一致。
options: A. I ran for 20 minutes. I ate egg and apple. I slept 9 hour.
B. I ran for twenty minutes. I ate an egg and an apple. I slept for 9 hours.
C. I run for 20 minutes. I eat an egg and apple. I sleep 9 hours.
D. I ran for 20 minutes. I eat eggs and apples. I slept for nine hours.

exercises.question: Your classmate asks: 'What's your favorite app? Why do you like it?' Which answer introduces the app AND gives three features correctly?
exercises.explanation: C 正确介绍了 Camera 并给出三个真实功能。A 只说感受没讲功能;B 中 download videos 和 make phone calls 不是 Music 的功能;D 把 app 说成 phone,概念混淆。
options: A. My favorite app is Photos. It is very popular.
B. My favorite app is Music. It can play songs, download videos, and make phone calls.
C. My favorite app is Camera. It can take photos, record videos, and save pictures.
D. My favorite app is a phone. It is fun.

exercises.question: Look at the picture of a space station. There are three words in the box: phone / robot / electric car. Which word can complete BOTH sentences? 'This is a ____. It can help astronauts work on the space station.' AND 'A ____ can also help people do housework at home.'
exercises.explanation: 机器人(robot)在太空站可以帮助宇航员工作,在家里也可以帮助人们做家务,所以两个空都填 robot。其他选项:phone(电话)主要用于通话,electric car(电动车)主要用于出行,都不符合两个语境。
options: A. phone
B. robot
C. electric car
D. phone and robot
exercises._original_question: Look at the picture of a space station. Complete the sentence using two words from the box: phone /
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: Your classmate shows you a news photo of a dried-up river. Which sentence best follows the structure of 'what happened + why + what I can do'?
exercises.explanation: A 完整包含'发生了什么(河干了)+为什么(人们浪费水)+我能做什么(在家节约用水)',是标准结构。B离题,C无意义重复,D缺少行动倡议,均不符合要求。
options: A. The river is dry because people waste water, and I will save water at home.
B. I don't like the river. It is boring. I want to play games.
C. Many people are thirsty. They drink water. Water is wet.
D. Climate change is a big problem in the world. I don't know what to do.

exercises.question: 老师播放英语录音说 'Good morning, Tom!'，听完之后我们应该怎么做？
exercises.explanation: 模仿跟读要先听后读，不依赖中文翻译。A、D 都先想中文，C 把顺序搞反了。
options: A. 先想中文意思，再慢慢读出来
B. 立刻跟着录音读，不先想中文
C. 先举手问 Tom 是谁，再跟读
D. 等老师翻译成中文，再读

exercises.question: You see a picture of a big, green animal with sharp teeth standing in a forest. The sentence says: "The dinosaur is very tall." What does "dinosaur" mean?
exercises.explanation: 图片里是一只又高又大的恐龙,结合 "tall"(高) 可推断 dinosaur 是恐龙。A 项体型不符,C、D 项用 tall 形容不准确。
options: A. 大象
B. 恐龙
C. 老虎
D. 长颈鹿

exercises.question: Anna 把单词分成三堆：nouns 堆有 cat、apple、teacher；verbs 堆有 run、jump、eat；adjectives 堆有 beautiful、quickly、happy。下面哪个单词被她分错了？
exercises.explanation: quickly 是副词，不是形容词，应放入副词堆；其余三个单词的词性与分组一致。
options: A. teacher（放在 nouns 堆）
B. jump（放在 verbs 堆）
C. quickly（放在 adjectives 堆）
D. beautiful（放在 adjectives 堆）
